subject: Altuna Systems — evaluation onboarding, milestones & roles
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@altuna.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Altuna Systems — initial post-call recap and next steps

Hi Ben — great conversation this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the items we agreed to follow up on: 

- Core evaluation goals: validate end-to-end latency at 99th percentile under your 250k monthly inference volume; measure cost per 1k tokens and evict/reload behavior for your burst traffic; verify private VPC deployment for PHI redaction flow.
- Success criteria you called out: 1) <50ms median token latency on representative queries, 2) <2% drop in throughput after 48-hour sustained run, 3) final readout with clear pass/fail checklist for compliance.
- Proposed pilot scope: 2-week sandbox run -> 3-week POC with production-like dataset (anonymized) -> final readout.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Share a mutual action plan + milestone calendar (attached).
2) Schedule a 30–45m kickoff to align tech owners and test data window (Jonas to lead the technical onboarding).
3) Provide SOC2 evidence and network diagram for your security review (we can provide a redacted diagram).

Can you confirm availability for a kickoff on Thu 8/13 or Fri 8/14 morning (PDT)? Also confirm who from your side will own acceptance criteria and procurement.

Thanks — Maya

--
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: ALTUNA-mutual-action-plan-20260811.xlsx (mutual action plan, milestones, owner matrix)

From: Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@altuna.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@altuna.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Altuna Systems — initial post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Maya — appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick confirms: 

- Altuna accepts the proposed three-phase approach. Our acceptance owner will be me for functional criteria and Procurement will own commercial/contract gating.
- SOC2 docs: Procurement asked for the redacted network diagram + SOC2 section on data retention; I copied them on this reply.
- Kickoff: Thu 8/13 at 10:00am PDT works for my team (I can loop in our SRE lead if needed).

One ask: can you add a short template for evaluation queries and a sample script we can run to reproduce the latency numbers? That would speed up our side.

Ben
Head of AI Engineering | Altuna Systems
ben.holloway@altuna.com | +1 (617) 555-9221

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@altuna.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Altuna Systems — initial post-call recap and next steps

Hi Ben — thanks, confirmed for Thu 8/13 10:00am PDT. Agenda suggestion (30–45m):

1) Introductions + roles (5m)
2) Test dataset & ingestion approach — scope and anonymization (10m)
3) Evaluation harness & query templates (10m)
4) Infra plan: VPC peering, credentials, and data handling (10m)
5) Milestones, success criteria mapping, and go/no-go gates (5–10m)

I've added a short evaluation query script and an example query set to the mutual action plan in the drive link (see related_links). Marcus will own the load generator and can share the runbook.

See you Thu. — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@altuna.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@altuna.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan + kickoff invite (attachments + links)

Ben / team — sending the formal M.A.P. and kickoff calendar invite. Highlights in the attached workbook: 

- Week 0 (onboarding): VPC peering, credentials, sample dataset ingest, smoke tests. Owner: Jonas.
- Week 1–2 (sandbox validation): run 4 load windows (baseline, burst, sustained 48h, cold-start), collect token-level latency + KV cache hit rate. Owner: Marcus.
- Week 3 (readout & remediation): execute agreed regressions, produce pass/fail readout with annotated logs. Owner: Ben (functional), Procurement (commercial gate).

Please review the acceptance checklist in tab 3 of ALTUNA-mutual-action-plan-20260811.xlsx and flag any items you want changed before the kickoff.

Attachment: ALTUNA-mutual-action-plan-20260811.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBAltunaEvalDocs
HubSpot: ALT-2026-0123

Thanks — Maya

From: Ben Holloway <ben.holloway@altuna.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@altuna.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + kickoff invite (attachments + links)

Thanks everyone — reviewed the M.A.P. and it looks good. A couple of small adjustments we made on our side (tracking in the drive doc):

- Add an explicit anonymization step + checklist before any dataset leaves our environment (Procurement insisted).
- Add a nightly snapshot of run metrics to the shared folder for easier correlation.

Confirming kickoff Thu 8/13 10:00am PDT — I’ll share a short intro deck and invite our SRE (Priya Shah) to the call. Procurement will start a Statement of Work draft; they asked for a week turnaround on a redline.

See you in an hour.

Ben
Head of AI Engineering | Altuna Systems
